name: Woodys Stadelbar
kurzbeschreibung: Tyrolean-style Stadelbar in Kitzbühel – cosy, casual and with a great atmosphere, open daily from 4 p.m.
beschreibung: The Woody'Stadlbar in Kitzbühel is a Tyrolean-style barn bar that stands out above all for its cosy and casual atmosphere. The establishment at Hornweg 4 is listed in the snack bar and bar/pub categories and is a popular meeting place for locals and guests looking for a relaxed evening with a great atmosphere. In addition to drinks, small dishes are also offered. According to Kitzbühel Tourismus, the bar is open daily from 16:00 to 23:00; these opening hours apply until 1 November 2026. Payment can be made in cash as well as by credit or debit card. The Woody'Stadlbar is located in the centre of Kitzbühel, nestled in the mountain scenery of the Kitzbühel Alps, making it an ideal place to wind down after a day in the mountains.
